steps.code:
# Parse the archive file content to extract song titles and artists.
import re

archive_content = archive_file['content']
songs_to_archive = []
for line in archive_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_info = line[2:].strip()
        # Format: "Song Title by Artist"
        match = re.match(r'^(.*?)\s+by\s+(.*)$', song_info)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artist = match.group(2).strip()
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})

print(f"Number of songs to archive: {len(songs_to_archive)}")
print(songs_to_archive)
